language.notes: uk checks Ukrainian text markers; not a language-quality or fact-check guarantee.

fixedLinks.notes: A JSON array of fixed HTTP(S) presentation links permitted in addition to selected-source URLs. Every other link must still be selected, and all selected sources must still be cited.

requiredPrefix.notes: A byte-exact literal prefix required at the beginning of the draft before any approval gate.

requiredHeadings.notes: A JSON array of exact level-two Markdown headings. When set, the draft must contain exactly this ordered list.

result.notes: Check selected citation URLs, optional fixed presentation links, and optional literal format contracts; not a factual-accuracy guarantee.
